answer: Our form records list seven forms that took effect on February 1, 2026. Five are brand-new: NW-DMG-1 (Damage disclosure), NW-EST-1 (Heir and estate affidavit), NW-LPA-1 (Lender payoff authorization, for loans only), NW-MIL-1 (Deployed owner authorization) and NW-PLT-1 (Plate return receipt, California). The other two replace retired forms: NW-ODO-2 (Odometer disclosure statement) replaced NW-ODO-1, and NW-POA-2 (Power of attorney, e-sign) replaced the notarized NW-POA-1. An NW-POA-1 signed before February 1, 2026 was accepted only until June 30, 2026, and Georgia still requires a power of attorney to be notarized, including NW-POA-2.
